public_body: Ashland Open Space And Recreation Committee
overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation. The notice-topic allegation was declined as untimely, and the minutes allegation failed because the committee approved the minutes within two months, an appropriate time.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the committee's October 19 meeting discussed a topic not listed on the posted notice.
allegations.key_passage: Because the complaint was filed with the Board two months after the meeting, we find that the allegation is untimely and we decline to review it.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the committee has failed to file meeting minutes since July 12.
allegations.key_passage: The Committee approved all of the minutes at issue within two months. We find this to be an appropriate amount of time for approving minutes.
